title: Second projection pasting under shrinking the graph intersection
statement: Let A,c,H,a′,v,fac,S be as in [def-pur-etale-graph-neighborhood-words]. For the explicit second legs L2_H,L2_S and inverse intersection triangle K of [def-pur-etale-graph-shrink-intersection-words], and T=graphNeighborhoodTriangle, the natural transformations satisfy L2_H.hom≫T.hom=K.hom≫L2_S.hom. This assertion uses only the second intersection projection and its two open shrinking maps; it does not assert compatibility of the whole middle word.

source.place: Tags 0F7D (lemma-shriek-proper-and-open-compose-horizontal) and 0F7J (lemma-shriek-composition), the intersection subcalculation of the agent-stated product-graph extension in lem-pur-etale-graph-shrink-middle-pasting. This is an explicit new sub-obligation, not a claim that the Stacks source states this product-graph formula verbatim.

proof.text: Use graphIntersectionShrink_graph, graphNeighborhoodShrink_graph, graphIntersectionShrink_snd and graphIntersectionShrink_open_fac. The two projection factorizations of each proper graph are pullback.lift_snd, and both ambient open words are identified with the second projection using pullback.condition. All graph maps and open immersions are the original constructed ones.

Reuse the proved private concrete_triangle_transport helper of EtaleRefinementGraphMiddleTransport, with its second top open equal to the identity. Postcompose with the derived identity-extension comparison. Expanding the definition of rightDerivedLowerStarCompOpenImmersionLowerShriekIso gives composition of two proper/open triangles. The general open compositor associativity follows by specializing CompactSupportFormalism.shComp'_assoc through the proved unbounded_sh_comp normalization. These are proved private helpers, not new obligations.

Define a private extendedTriangle comparison by the open compositor followed by the proper/open triangle, with the outside open extension retained. Prove its transitivity componentwise: move the triangle through the next open compositor by naturality; use open compositor associativity; apply the preceding two-triangle composition identity and cancel the compositor and its inverse. Apply transitivity to the two routes (intersection shrink, old second projection) and (smaller second projection, neighborhood shrink). Their composite maps agree by graphIntersectionShrink_snd. Cancel the intersection and neighborhood comparisons, whisker by the fixed ambient proper direct image, and expand the specified words and associators. This yields exactly the second-leg equation.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleGraphShrinkSecondLeg
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X Z W : Scheme.{u}} {h : X ⟶ Z} (c : Compactification h)
    (H : EtaleGraphPresentation h) (a' : X ⟶ W) (v : W ⟶ H.U)
    [IsProper a'] [IsOpenImmersion v] (fac : a' ≫ v = H.a) :
    (H.graphIntersectionLeg₂ c A).hom ≫ (H.graphNeighborhoodTriangle c A a' v fac).hom =
      (H.graphIntersectionShrinkIso c A a' v fac).hom ≫
        ((H.shrink a' v fac).graphIntersectionLeg₂ c A).hom
